note: Custom Publishing Options defines a config entity custom_publishing_option (config prefix custom_pub.custom_publishing_option.<id>; keys id, label, description, publish_under_promote_options). Creating one installs a boolean base field on the node entity named after the option id (postSave), deleting it uninstalls that field (postDelete). It provides a per-option permission 'can set node publish state to <id>' plus static 'administer custom publishing options', an Action plugin set_custom_publishing_option_value, a Rules action and a d7 migrate source. Admin route entity.custom_publishing_option.collection at /admin/config/content/custom_publishing_option. No Drush, no plugin types. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real config entity + the auto-installed node base field (cpub_known / cpub_task).

evals.prompt: In Drupal, when I create a Custom Publishing Option with the custom_pub module, what does it add to my nodes, and where in the admin UI do I manage these options?
evals.expected_output: Each option is a custom_publishing_option config entity; creating one installs a boolean base field on the node entity (named after the option id) that shows as a checkbox on the node form and is usable in Views. Manage them at /admin/config/content/custom_publishing_option (route entity.custom_publishing_option.collection).

evals.prompt: With custom_pub, how is access to setting a specific custom publishing option controlled, and what permission is needed to manage the options themselves?
must_contain_any: can set node publish state to
evals.expected_output: There is a dynamic per-option permission 'can set node publish state to <option_id>' that controls whether that option's checkbox shows on the node form, plus the static 'administer custom publishing options' permission to create/edit/delete options. (Note: to also see core status/promote/sticky a role still needs 'administer nodes'.)

evals.prompt: How can I bulk-set a custom publishing option on many nodes at once with the custom_pub module? Name the mechanism it provides.
evals.expected_output: It ships a node Action plugin, set_custom_publishing_option_value ('Set a custom publish option value on a node'), configurable with an option id and a boolean value; run it from a View/VBO or the content overview to bulk-set the option. Programmatically the option is just a node boolean field: $node->set('<id>', TRUE).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a custom publishing option named cpub_known defined via custom_pub. Inspect the live site and state the machine name of the boolean node field that this option added.
evals.expected_output: The node base field is cpub_known (same as the option id). The option config entity custom_pub.custom_publishing_option.cpub_known exists and its postSave installed a boolean base field named cpub_known on node.

evals.prompt: Inspect the custom publishing option cpub_known on this site. Is it configured to appear under core's 'Promotion options' on the node form? Read the live config to answer.
evals.expected_output: Yes: custom_pub.custom_publishing_option.cpub_known has publish_under_promote_options: true, so its checkbox is grouped under core's Promotion options rather than the separate Custom Publish Options section.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the custom_pub module to create a new custom publishing option with the machine id 'cpub_task' (label 'Task State'). Apply it to the live site so that it adds its boolean field to nodes.
evals.expected_output: A custom_publishing_option config entity with id cpub_task exists (custom_pub.custom_publishing_option.cpub_task) and its postSave installed a boolean base field named cpub_task on the node entity. Create it via CustomPublishingOption::create(['id'=>'cpub_task','label'=>'Task State',...])->save() or the add form at /admin/config/content/custom_publishing_option/add.

evals.prompt: Besides 'Published', I want a new on/off marker I can tick on my content, with the internal name 'cpub_task' and the label 'Task State'. Please add that new publishing marker to my Drupal site so it shows up as a checkbox on content.
evals.expected_output: Create a custom_publishing_option with id cpub_task; its postSave installs a boolean node base field named cpub_task shown as a checkbox on the node form.
